user.title: Connect to go-eCharger
user.description: Enter the IP address or hostname of the charger. The local HTTP API must be enabled in the go-eCharger app.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the charger status is polled, in seconds (go-e recommends at least 5).
data_description.auto_reboot_no_ground: The charger sometimes reports a spurious "No ground" error after months of uptime that only a reboot clears. When enabled, the charger is rebooted once when the error appears, and not again until a "No error" status was seen.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure go-eCharger
reconfigure.description: Change the address of the charger or the refresh interval.
